text:
Maya Singh: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — need owners and timelines for token validation, audit-log gaps, and secrets rotation. Any volunteers?

Omar Reyes: I'll take token validation. estimate 2 weeks; need infra for canary + 1 more API gate.

Kevin Lin: I can own audit logging parity. @Maya can you drop the list of endpoints missing logs?

Maya Singh: pasted the list here: s3://redwood-postmortem/artifacts/missing-audit-endpoints.csv
Also note severity: medium for user-facing endpoints, high for admin/keys.

sre-bot: ticket INF-5230 created and assigned to Omar Reyes (token validation) due 2026-05-20
sre-bot: ticket INF-5231 created and assigned to Kevin Lin (audit parity) due 2026-06-03

Alice Chen: Suggest splitting token work: (1) validation metrics/alert, (2) server-side schema enforcement, (3) rotation/cleanup job. I'll file sub-tasks.

Maya Singh: Action items: Omar -> INF-5230 plan + canary checklist by 2026-05-20; Kevin -> INF-5231 audit run + reconciliation by 2026-06-03; Alice -> sub-tasks by EOD. I'll update postmortem and trigger weekly cadence with owners. :thumbsup:

Omar Reyes: Acknowledged, will post design doc tomorrow.

Kevin Lin: ack, will start endpoint inventory this afternoon.

Maya Singh: Quick note on recurring pattern: tokens with length>32 sometimes skip validation due to legacy svc proxy. Adding runbook item and short-term firewall rule. Will ping infra legal for KMS policy alignment.

Alice Chen: I'll add the rotation checklist to the secrets runbook and link INF-5232.

sre-bot: INF-5232 created: secrets-rotation-checklist assigned to Alice Chen, due 2026-05-27
